observed_mechanics: Push ESI and read the target pointer from the incoming ESP+0x08 slot into ESI.
Form this-4 in EAX with LEA and store it at target+0x4.
Load this->vtable into EDX, load vtable slot +0x14 into EAX, and call it with ECX still holding this and no pushed argument.
Store the returned word at target+0xc.
Restore ESI and return with RET 0x4.
